PENTARYN_CREATURES.label: Your creatures
PENTARYN_CREATURES.hint: Click: select and show · Double-click: open sheet

lightRadius.name: Creature light (ft)
lightRadius.hint: Bright light on every creature a player controls (summons, familiars, Arcane Eye), so it never disappears in the dark. Foundry measures token light from the token's edge: 5 also lights the squares around it, 0.5 lights little more than its own square. 0 turns the light off and removes it from every token it was added to. Never applied to player characters, and never replaces a light a token already has. To keep one creature dark, set its light to 0 in Token Config: it stays off.

ownerSees.name: Players always see their own tokens
ownerSees.hint: A token a player owns stays visible to that player even when nothing they control can see it, e.g. an Invisible Arcane Eye in the dark. Tokens the GM has hidden stay hidden.

showStrip.name: Show the "Your creatures" strip
showStrip.hint: Portraits of the tokens you control on this scene, above the hotbar, once you have more than one. Click to select and pan to one, double-click to open its sheet.

floatOverHud.name: Strip floats above the Combat HUD
floatOverHud.hint: While the Combat HUD is open it covers the hotbar, and the strip sat behind its bars. With this on the strip moves up to sit just above the HUD, so its portraits can be clicked. Off: it stays above the hotbar.

summonLibrary.name: Summon library for players
summonLibrary.hint: Players whose role may not create actors can still summon from a compendium (Mage Hand, Find Familiar, a steed): the GM's client makes the creature for them, owned by them, in "PC Summons & Forms / <name> — summons & forms", and every later summon reuses it. Needs a GM logged in the first time each creature is summoned. Off: such a summon fails with dnd5e's Create New Actors message.

summon.noGM: a GM must be logged in to add this creature to your summon library (only the first time)
